name: Guff Runetotem
guide_text: This hero is the best with cycle tribes, because the hero power benefits from you buying a ton of cards. These tribes include Pirates, Elementals, and Murlocs, and try to play one of these compositions.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up on either turn 6 or turn 7. This'll allow you to see an early 5 drop and 6 drop that determine your direction.
